headline: Anti-crisis plan exhausts fiscal reform in the Dominican Republic
summary: Finance Minister Magín Díaz said measures approved by Congress under the anticrisis plan exhausted room for further fiscal changes. The government will manage 2027 with available resources.
why: Fiscal policy and tax changes affect government borrowing needs, public spending and investor views of sovereign credit in the Dominican Republic.
original_headline: Plan anticrisis agota reforma fiscal en República Dominicana
